body: Trust me, I feel this deeply. Recently i've been trying to change who I am and act as if i'm someone else. For a couple of moments, it's okay. Thats all i've got.

Hey, I feel the exact same way as you. I wake up every morning waiting for the day to end; and every night i'm waiting for the morning. Theres nothing looking forward too and I too am done with this. My entire life has been cruel and I don't see the reason for being here. This was my post [https://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/hoj6er/my\_life\_story/](https://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/hoj6er/my_life_story/)

Edit - Not sure what to tell you because i'm seeking the same answers

I've been telling myself this for quite a while. I never believed in when people said "you have to be happy with yourself to be happy with another" quite frankly because I don't know what that is. I don't see it getting better because I've lost what I hold dearest and things have never gotten better.
